source_acquisition.search_note: PDF p.1 explicitly links https://github.com/Feng-Hong/ImbDiff-CM; the OpenReview record, reading source inventory and local corpus/visual_sources/iclr-2026-2a842dd4a787 directory were checked. Authenticated gh metadata and the recursive main tree confirm the author repository and its README title, but the 42 tracked blobs contain training, sampling, metrics, classification and configuration files only: no plot*/figure*/visual*/table* script, notebook, TeX/TikZ/PGF/SVG visual source or rendered figure assets. The torch-fidelity repository is only the linked Inception checkpoint dependency. A GitHub repository search for the full method phrase found no additional candidate. The repository is therefore selected for direct paper identity but classified as repository_without_visual_source.

paper_style.palette_strategy: 正文图表混合使用蓝/红双轴诊断、蓝/黄/绿/粉方法色、方法图的蓝绿橙紫组件色和淡粉 CM 行；qualitative grids 保留自然图像颜色而不将其当作量化编码。主要定量图依赖颜色并辅以轴/图例/线型，灰度安全性有限。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF 文字、公式、caption、表格规则与大量标签为向量/PDF font objects；Figure 1/2/3 和 appendix 样本、plot panels 是嵌入 JPEG/JPX/栅格图像，整体为 mixed。200 dpi 渲染覆盖物理页 1–40，未把图片对象误计为新增 Figure/Table。
paper_style.style_consistency: ICLR 双栏正文和单栏 appendix 共享 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 字体、booktabs 风格和橙色 cross-reference；主表 CM 行常用淡粉底与粗体，定量曲线重复蓝色 OC reference/橙色 CM。附录图幅和字号更不均一，宽阔样本页与紧凑表页之间存在密度差异。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1: (a) Real images from Imb. CelebA (Imbalance Ratio IR = 100) and generated images from DDPM and our method. Images are randomly sampled. (b) Relative per-class loss change, defined as (Lcpruned − Lcraw )/Lcraw , for a DDPM model trained on Imb. CIFAR-100 (IR = 100) when 10% of its parameters with the smallest L1-Norm are pruned. Raw losses and absolute loss changes are provided in Figs. G.1 and G.2.

color.semantic_mapping: Figure 1(a) uses natural image colors; panel (b) maps blue to sample number and dark red to relative loss change, with matching axis/legend labels.

encodings.x: panel (b) Class Index, 0–100; panel (a) ordered image columns
encodings.y: panel (b) left Sample Number and right Relative Loss Change
encodings.color: panel (b) blue sample-count curve and red loss-change curve; natural image colors in panel (a)
encodings.shape: panel (a) 2×3 image tiles per class/method; panel (b) smooth curves
encodings.line: two solid curves with twin y axes; panel (a) row and column labels
encodings.text: Female (Majority), Male (Minority), FID 7.143/16.425/6.815/12.788, and formula for relative change

figures.data_and_statistics: Panel (a) shows balanced real references against DDPM and CM samples for Female/Male, with per-class FID point values. Panel (b) plots 100 class-index observations: sample count decreases from roughly 500 to near zero, while relative loss change rises toward the tail after pruning the 10% smallest-L1 parameters. No replicate, error bar, sample denominator or confidence interval is displayed.
figures.evidence_relation: Introduction minority-quality failure → Fig. 1(a) visualizes the Female/Male gap → Fig. 1(b) links similar raw losses to pruning sensitivity → Figs. G.1–G.2 provide the raw and absolute diagnostics → Theorems 2.1/3.1 motivate reserved capacity.
design_strengths: The two panels place a perceptual failure and a capacity-sensitivity proxy in one headline object.
Twin axes and a legend preserve the distinction between class frequency and loss response; row labels make the minority comparison immediate.
design_weaknesses: Natural-image sampling is representative rather than exhaustive, and the caption does not identify the number of generated samples.
Twin-axis chart has a small plotting area and no uncertainty; L1 pruning is a proxy for capacity rather than a direct capacity measurement.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a two-panel diagnostic: pair a matched real/baseline/method grid with a quantitative mechanism proxy, and keep class frequency and failure response on explicitly labeled axes.

Panel (c) uses direct group labels and a local legend, so the mechanism diagram and outcome chart can be read in sequence.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 先把 minority failure/fragility 变成可见问题；Figure 2 把 θg/θe reservation/allocation 接到 Many/Medium/Few；Tables 1–6 依次完成结构反事实、主指标、类级/分辨率/ArtBench 对照；Figure 4、Table 7 和 G.3–G.6 做参数/组件消融；G.7–G.13 将视觉、human/downstream、solver/model/task 扩展移入附录。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Figure/Table caption 均以标签+动作开头，正文 caption 多包含 dataset、IR、comparison 和 appendix pointer；主表 caption 解释指标箭头与 best/second-best，附录样本 caption 明确 random selection。弱点是大量 caption 只描述对象或复用“same setting”，未写 seed、分母和 uncertainty。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 定量主表统一用 Method + 指标列，跨 setting 以 IR/dataset/resolution 多级 header 分组；Many/Medium/Few 作为同一 stratum vocabulary；↑/↓ 表示方向。Mean±Std 镜像表在 G.1–G.6 延续列顺序，但运行单位未定义。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Eq. (1) 的 θg⊕θe、Eq. (2–4) 的 LCon/LDiv/λ 由 Figure 2 解释，Table 1/E.2 排除“low-rank/LoRA/MoE 本身”替代解释，Figure 4 和 Table 7 分别测试 λ/rank/UNet、branch 与 loss deletion。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Figures 1–4、Tables 1–7 是 headline/interface；G.1–G.2 回补 Figure 1 诊断，G.3–G.6 回补标准差/消融，G.7–G.8 回补 human/downstream/visual branch，G.9–G.13 回补 broader settings、Overlap 和 classification。物理 PDF appendix 完整包含这些对象，没有独立 supplementary 文件。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: PDF 主体使用 Nimbus Roman No9 L 与 Computer Modern math，表格字号约 6.5–7.5 pt；嵌入 raster plot 的 sans-serif 标签和 appendix 样本标题存在估计差异。caption 标题未统一粗体。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: CM 在定量表中主要由淡粉底/粗体/下划线识别，在图中多为橙/红色；OC 常为蓝色虚线或绿色/蓝色 bar，DDPM/CBDM/OC/CM bar 色在 Figure 2/4 复用但非完全统一。自然图像页没有方法色语义，必须依赖行/块标签。

most_reusable_patterns: 把问题诊断、机制接口和分层性能放在 Figure 1/2 的连续视觉链中，而不是只给 overall metric。
用 Many/Medium/Few 与 Female/Male 等显式 strata header 把 minority claim 绑定到 per-class/per-split 指标。
用 matched structural alternative、branch-only/full 和 loss deletion 组成反事实三件套，再以 Mean±Std mirror 放入 appendix。
对生成质量同时提供 matched qualitative rows、自然图像 reference 和 FID/KID/Recall 等互补指标。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：CelebA real/DDPM/CM 与 CIFAR-100 pruning twin-axis diagnostic 同屏，最有效地建立问题→机制代理。
Figure 2：reservation→allocation→Many/Medium/Few 的三栏接口，把方法设计直接接到 tail outcome。
Table 7：θg-only/full 与 LCon/LDiv deletion 在同一页，最接近组件职责和机制必要性的数值反事实。
Table 2/3/4/6：跨 IR、split、class 和 ArtBench 的主结果面，提供 headline 与异质性边界。
failure_patterns: 把 L1-pruning sensitivity 或 low-rank rank 当作真实 representational capacity，却没有 per-layer capacity map、gradient-share calibration、αr 估计或 runtime/parameter accounting。
主表只给 point estimates，Mean±Std 移到附录但未说明 runs、seed、Std repeat unit，且没有 CI/检验。
大规模 8×8 qualitative grids 没有 class/resolution/stratum labels，无法由随机样本验证 tail coverage。
caption 经常依赖“same setting”或只说 randomly selected，缺少 prompt、分母、selection frame 和不确定性；人评/下游扩展也只有小样本单点。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文以 capacity 被 majority 占用的诊断为起点，用 θg/θe 的 reservation/allocation 示意连接到 Many/Medium/Few 与跨数据集 headline 表，再用结构、loss、rank 和架构反事实及附录样本/扩展支撑 CM 对 minority 的保护。
